Applying for Admission
Applying for admission is easy through GradApp, our graduate admission application.
Here are the steps:
Create your profile
You will need to provide basic personal information and your educational history
Start your application
Select your campus/location and program of choice to begin (program-specific instructions will be detailed on the application once started)
What should you expect on the application?
Each graduate program has its own set of requirements in addition to the University of Arizona Graduate College's minimum requirements. For example, the Graduate College does not require entrance exams, such as the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), but many graduate programs do. Please refer to our Graduate Admissions Guides for program-specific requirements and application deadlines.
Please note: most University of Arizona graduate programs do not keep their applications open year-round. It is common for program-specific application questions only to be available 1 -3 months prior to the deadline; however, you can always begin your application in GradApp - completing the basic profile information and uploading transcripts - and come back to GradApp later to complete program-specific application questions.
Submit Events
Colleges and programs are encouraged to submit events for prospective students using our form. Once approved, your event will appear on the Future Students calendar, helping students discover and engage with your programs. Don’t miss the chance to connect with future students and showcase what your program has to offer.
